review.official:
A famous action movie star from
Yan
, FEater was forced to give up her film career after contracting
Oripathy
. She found a new purpose in life at
Rhodes Island
.

files.description:
Imaging tests for this Operator showed blurry outlines of internal organs with visible dark spots. Unusually high concentrations of Originium particles were present in her circulatory system, indicating infection and confirming her as Infected at this stage.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 7.2% 
Visible traces of Originium on the subject's right leg, but it has not yet crystallized. 

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.21u/L 
FEater's infection is still in early stages and has yet to substantially impact her health.

FEater studied martial arts for many years prior to entering the film industry. She is the heir to the Tie Yi Liu He Quan, the Universal Fist of the Iron Will, one of Yan's great martial arts traditions. FEater has mastered all Five Elements, Eight Strikes, and Twelve Forms of her art, giving her the ability to deal devastating blows in the blink of an eye.

After contracting Oripathy, FEater's acting career and aspirations came to a screeching halt. But she didn't give into depression like one might expect, since movies to her were just one vehicle for delivering righteousness. The optimistic former star quickly landed back on her feet.

Even after becoming a movie star, even having been a legendary martial arts master, FEater has always been someone very approachable. In fact, she is actually rather naive and gets along easily with other Operators. Her hobbies include movies, of course, as well as Yan food, and chugging alcohol with a friendly crowd.

lines.title: Appointed as Assistant
lines.text: So... I have to just stand here and not do anything? Laaaame.

lines.title: Talk 1
lines.text: These gauntlets aren't that heavy. See? Even a dainty little girl like me can carry 'em around real easy.

lines.title: Talk 2
lines.text: You remember fighting by my side before? Can't say I remember fighting by yours, sorry... I just fight for what's right, that's all.

lines.title: Talk 3
lines.text: Hah. That boxer, Beehunter? She's really something! I enjoyed sparring with her so much, I had to throw out some serious moves. And she's got an amazing honey collection too. Wanna visit her with me next time? You gotta learn some kung fu first, though.

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 1
lines.text: Reading a movie magazine...? Well, guess what? The 'hot kung-fu actress' mentioned in this article is ME! What? You don't believe me? Come on, look! This is me, can't you tell? C'mon, that's definitely me!

lines.title: Talk after Promotion 2
lines.text: Do I regret forgoing my previous life? Well, sometimes, of course. But the world ain't kind to us Infected. Lots of places I'm not allowed to go. It blows.

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
lines.text: There's a street full of food stalls in the neighboring city. And... a candy shop over there? And a theme park? Aww, Doctor, can I get a day off? I wanna check out these places!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
lines.text: Am I satisfied with life at Rhodes Island, you ask? Hm, to be honest... It's even sweeter than what they show in the movies! I got cool opponents to practice with, top-notch food, and by working here, I'm doing something good for the world! What could be better!

lines.title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
lines.text: Doctor, look! What do you think about this script? Oh, who's gonna act in it, you wonder? You and I are gonna be the main characters! There's this scene where we leap from the roof of a thirty-story building and slide all the way down. Isn't that cool? Hey! Come back! Wait!

lines.title: Idle
lines.text: You're catching some z's, eh? Guess I'll slack off for a bit too. Man, this couch is so fluffy!

lines.title: Onboard
lines.text: You swear you've seen my face before? Probably saw it in a movie I was in! Call me FEater, and what I do from here is your call!

lines.title: Watching Battle Record
lines.text: It's over? Come on, let's watch just a while longer. We're almost at the fun part!

lines.title: Promotion 1
lines.text: Oooh! A promotion! Thanks so much, Doctor!

lines.title: Promotion 2
lines.text: This here's the perfect opportunity to show you some REAL kung fu!

lines.title: Added to Squad
lines.text: All right, it's show time!

lines.title: Appointed as Squad Leader
lines.text: Huh? I'm the leader? Not sure how it'll go, but...

lines.title: Depart
lines.text: This is gonna be exciting!

lines.title: Begin Operation
lines.text: I'm FEater. Pleased to beat you!

lines.title: Selecting Operator 1
lines.text: Un-huh.

lines.title: Selecting Operator 2
lines.text: Here we go!

lines.title: Deployment 1
lines.text: All right!

lines.title: Deployment 2
lines.text: Show time!

lines.title: In Battle 1
lines.text: HI-YAH!

lines.title: In Battle 2
lines.text: This is straight out of one of my movies!

lines.title: In Battle 3
lines.text: From flexibility comes power!

lines.title: In Battle 4
lines.text: Who says a movie star couldn't be a real kung-fu master!

lines.title: 4-star Result
lines.text: Wow, it's over?

lines.title: 3-star Result
lines.text: It's over already? I was just starting to get warmed up.

lines.title: Sub 3-star Result
lines.text: Hey, it's no biggie. Just a few scratches and bruises.

lines.title: Operation Failure
lines.text: Aw... I just wanna go home and sleep...

lines.title: Assigned to Facility
lines.text: Now that's stylin'!

lines.title: Tap
lines.text: Stop that, I'm getting dizzy!

lines.title: Trust Tap
lines.text: Hey, Doctor, want my autograph? I'll take a pic with you if you want, too!

lines.title: Title
lines.text: Arknights.

lines.title: New Year's blessing
lines.text: Happy New Year, Doctor! Hehe, back in the old days, theaters would screen my movies this time every year, all playing to a full house!  Still, can't live in the past forever. I gotta punch ahead, and people gotta move on forward. Let's forget all our grievances for today!

lines.title: Greeting
lines.text: Did you have breakfast yet, Doctor?

lines.title: Birthday
lines.text: Doctor, happy birthday! There's this saying that 'life's a movie you can't reshoot,' so when it comes to a key scene, you've gotta live life like you're on fire! Any birthday wishes, Doctor? Gimme a wish as cool as the lead of an action movie, and I'll help you make it come true!

lines.title: Anniversary Celebration
lines.text: After I became an Infected, I thought for a bit that my career and my life were both over. Rhodes didn't just rein in my illness, but also gave me a fresh start. Standing up again in dire straits is exactly what the hero does, right? Doctor, Let's climb back to the top, together!
